note: Judith Basin County (MT) publishes no zoning districts layer. A third-party summary says unincorporated county has no comprehensive zoning code (county has only subdivision review under MCA 76-3). Searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub for zoning returned no Judith Basin layer. The county seat Stanford and town of Hobson have no zoning GIS found; Geyser is an unincorporated CDP. The county website lists no zoning or GIS service.
